description: SSMS script parsing (importer spec §3): INSERT rows with their column lists, values kept as the source wrote them; GO, SET, USE, comments and CREATE/ALTER skipped; anything else stops with the line number.

cases.name: one row with every kind of value
cases.input:
SET IDENTITY_INSERT [dbo].[INV_Item] ON 
INSERT [dbo].[INV_Item] ([ItemID], [ItemName], [Price], [Cost], [Qty], [Active], [Updated], [Note], [Image]) VALUES (N'0001234', N'OIL FILTER', CAST(1250.00 AS Decimal(18, 2)), -4.50, 12, CAST(1 AS bit), CAST(0x0000B3AB00E7958C AS DateTime), NULL, 0xFFD8AB)
GO
SET IDENTITY_INSERT [dbo].[INV_Item] OFF

cases.name: strings with quotes, line breaks and Urdu
cases.input:
INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a], [b], [c]) VALUES (N'DON''T DROP', N'line one
line two', N'کراچی')

cases.name: plain strings, an empty string and digits kept exactly
cases.input: INSERT INTO dbo.T (a, b, c, d) VALUES ('x', N'', 0007, 1.500)

cases.name: several rows in one INSERT, and a semicolon
the string DateTime form, money, float and a date
cases.input: INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a], [b], [c], [d]) VALUES (CAST(N'2025-07-01T08:30:00.000' AS DateTime), CAST(99.9900 AS Money), CAST(1.5E-3 AS Float), CAST(N'2025-07-01' AS Date))

cases.name: comments, USE and a CREATE TABLE are skipped; rows keep their line numbers
cases.input:
USE [2024]
GO
/****** Object:  Table [dbo].[T] ******/
SET ANSI_NULLS ON
GO
CREATE TABLE [dbo].[T](
	[a] [int] NOT NULL,
	[b] [nvarchar](50) NULL
) ON [PRIMARY]
GO
-- data
INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a], [b]) VALUES (1, N'one')
INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a], [b]) VALUES (2, N'two')
GO
ALTER TABLE [dbo].[T] ADD  DEFAULT ((0)) FOR [a]
GO

cases.name: a database script's IF and EXEC batches are skipped up to GO
cases.input:
USE [master]
GO
CREATE DATABASE [DLX]
GO
IF (1 = FULLTEXTSERVICEPROPERTY('IsFullTextInstalled'))
begin
EXEC [DLX].[dbo].[sp_fulltext_database] @action = 'enable'
end
GO
EXEC sys.sp_db_vardecimal_storage_format N'DLX', N'ON'
GO
ALTER DATABASE [DLX] SET  READ_WRITE 
GO
INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a]) VALUES (1)

cases.name: SSMS progress lines (print) between data batches are skipped
cases.input:
INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a]) VALUES (1)
print 'Processed 100 total records'
GO
INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a]) VALUES (2)

cases.name: an empty script
other CASTs: binary, NULL and a DateTime without milliseconds
cases.input: INSERT [dbo].[T] ([a], [b], [c]) VALUES (CAST(0x1234AB AS VarBinary(3)), CAST(NULL AS DateTime), CAST(N'2025-07-01 08:30:00' AS DateTime))

cases.name: a last SET without a line break, and a comment left open at the end
an unclosed comment ends the script
a CREATE with no GO after it runs to the end
an unknown statement stops the run
a row with the wrong number of values
an unterminated string
an unknown value
a bad DateTime
a missing bracket
stray text
a binary value cast to a date
a DateTime string that isn't one
